preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree must be between 1 and 300,000.
The number of queries must be between 1 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= n and 0 <= d_i <= 10**9 and 1 <= x_i <= 10**9 for v_i, d_i, x_i in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must have valid vertex index, distance, and value within specified bounds.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers, one for each vertex.
All output values must be non-negative integers.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.split()[i-1]) == sum(x_i for v_i, d_i, x_i in queries if is_in_subtree(i, v_i, d_i)) for i in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: Each vertex's value must reflect the sum of all applicable query values based on subtree conditions.
